summary: Phase 6 User Platform Scanner/Signals Comprehensive Testing Complete - All 30 backend tests passed, full UI flow verified. NA-01 through NA-06 features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: NA-01 Scanner: POST /api/user/scanner/run and GET /api/user/scanner/results working correctly with user-scope
NA-02 Signals: GET /api/user/signals, POST /api/user/signal/{id}/approve, POST /api/user/signal/{id}/reject all working
Signal approval creates paper_position entry, updates portfolio (available_balance reduced, open_notional increased)
Signal rejection does NOT create order (order_position_id = null)
Role Separation: Admin token correctly gets 403 on all /api/user/* endpoints (9 endpoints tested)
Owner Scope Isolation: User1 and User2 data (scanner results, signals, portfolio) completely isolated
NA-06 Regression: Dashboard summary, bot-profiles, risk-settings endpoints still working for users
Frontend UI: User Dashboard, Portfolio, Trades, Scanner, Signals pages all render correctly with live data
Scanner Run UI: Mode selector (ASSISTED/AUTO/MANUAL), Scanner Run button, results table all functional
Signals UI: Approve/Reject buttons work, status updates to approved/rejected, portfolio metrics update
Alias Routes: /dashboard, /portfolio, /trades, /scanner, /signals all redirect to /user/* correctly
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during test execution, approved via API
